name: Pip
character: Pip is a small robot whose head and body are one single sky-blue ball, glossy and about as wide as it is tall. One grey ribbed antenna rises from the top and curves to the viewer's right, tipped with a yellow ball. Two very big round white eyes with black pupils sit side by side under two dark blue eyebrows; a tiny smiling mouth, no nose. A small grey disc sits on each side like an ear. A grey band crosses the lower body with three round yellow buttons on it. Short grey ribbed arms end in sky-blue mitten hands. One dark grey rubber wheel on a grey fork replaces legs. No fingers, no claws, no tail, no stripes, no clothes, no hat.
style: Flat vector cartoon drawing with thick dark blue outlines, simple rounded shapes, smooth glossy surfaces with soft highlights, even bright daylight and no harsh shadows, in cheerful pastel colours; fully animated cartoon, not a photograph, no text, no letters, no logos anywhere.
place: Every scene happens in one sunny playroom with pale yellow walls and a light wooden floor, a tall wooden shelf of coloured blocks against the back wall on the left, a round red rug in the middle of the floor, and a big round window with blue sky behind Pip on the right.
keep_same: the same round sky-blue robot character (one ball body, one bent grey antenna with a yellow ball, two big white eyes, two grey ear discs, a grey belt with three yellow buttons, sky-blue mitten hands, one dark grey wheel), the same sunny playroom with its pale yellow walls and light wooden floor, the same wooden block shelf against the back wall on the left, the same round red rug in the middle of the floor
